results.correct_value: Cougar Divide runs north-south and the route travels SOUTH from the trailhead to Chowder Ridge; Skyline Divide lies about 1.5 mi to the west across Deadhorse Creek; both join on Chowder Ridge and finish on the same northwest ridge
results.evidence: A geology field guide says Cougar Divide runs north-south, the trail heads south to a 5,800 ft saddle then on to Chowder Ridge's crest, with Skyline Divide about 1.5 mi to the west across Deadhorse Creek and the Dobbs Creek basin seen from the trail, not travelled. A hiking guide says the two approaches meet on Chowder Ridge and follow the same northwest ridge to the summit, and a trip-report summary says the Cougar Divide Trail goes south to the top of Chowder Ridge. The row's own pins put the trailhead north-northeast of the summit and the approach text says south. The baseFinding's 'north-west via Dobbs Creek' is corrected. The camp card's 'east along the ridge' is in bivy[] and left to the camping clean-up (no bivy patch).

patches.find: Cougar Divide comes in from the NORTH-WEST via Dobbs Creek; Skyline Divide comes in from the WEST along a much longer open ridge.

results.evidence: WSDOT gives only extremes and single years: earliest closure Oct 17 (2007), latest Jan 3 (1990), the 2025 closure on Dec 4 (initial gates MP 134 and Silver Star gate MP 171, later moving to MP 120 and Early Winters MP 178), and a record-late ordinary opening of May 25 (2011), with the 2026 full reopening on June 14 after storm repairs. A second source only says it closes in late fall and reopens in spring with no fixed date. Neither 'mid-November' nor 'early December', nor a 'mid-April to mid-June' vs 'mid/late April' reopening, is stated as typical by any source. Note access.seasonal does not render on this row (access.closures takes precedence), so only road.seasonalGate is on screen. A multi-year WSDOT closure/opening table would settle it.
